title: Our Story
lead: From garage to global RC community. Welcome to Martyx Industries — where precision engineering meets passion for RC modeling.

origin.title: How It All Started
origin.paragraph_1: It all started with a simple question: "Why do RC models have to be so complicated to assemble?"
origin.paragraph_2: As an avid RC enthusiast and engineer, I was tired of glue sticks, incompatible parts, and endless waiting for adhesives to dry. I wanted to build, not wait. I wanted precision-engineered parts that just fit.
origin.paragraph_3: So I took my 3D printer, CAD software, and mechanical engineering know-how — and started creating. The first prototype was far from perfect, but the principle worked: no glue, just screws. Modular design. Precise tolerances.
origin.paragraph_4: Today, after hundreds of hours of testing, dozens of iterations, and endless feedback from the community, we deliver what I always wanted: RC kits that simply work.

no_glue.title: No Glue. Just Engineering.
no_glue.description: Every model is designed with precision-fit screw connections. Why? Because we want you to disassemble, upgrade, and repair your build anytime. That's real DIY.

modular.title: Modular Design
modular.description: Our models are designed like LEGO for adults. Every subsystem is a standalone module — chassis, electronics, body. Want to experiment? Go ahead!

tested.title: Field Tested
tested.description: Every design goes through hundreds of hours of real-world testing. Not in CAD simulations — in actual terrain, on real printers, with real users.

precision.title: Engineering Precision
precision.description: Every part is designed in CAD software with tolerances down to tenths of a millimeter. It's not just a 3D model — it's a mechanical drawing.

community.title: Community First
community.description: We listen to our users. Every feedback, bug report, and improvement suggestion is our priority. You make us better.

quality.title: Quality Over Quantity
quality.description: We'd rather make one model perfectly than ten average ones. Every kit is the result of weeks of work and testing.

team.title: Small Team, Big Dreams
team.description: We're a small team of engineers, designers, and RC enthusiasts who believe the best things come from passion, not corporate spreadsheets. Every model is a personal project we pour our hearts into.

cta.title: Ready to Build Something Amazing?
cta.description: Explore our RC kits and experience what it's like to build something that's engineering-first.
